idea-plugin.name: Seshlog – Coding Agent Session Manager
idea-plugin.description:
List, search and resume your local AI coding-agent sessions — Claude Code today, Codex and OpenCode planned — from a tool window, titled the way the agent titles them, with one click to reopen any of them in a terminal tab.

  • Sessions grouped by project with title, branch, last activity and a live indicator
  • Full-text search across prompts and replies, not just titles
  • Preview pane showing the last messages of the selected session
  • Resume or fork a session into a new terminal tab; focus the tab if it is already running
  • Restore the sessions that were running when the IDE was closed
Entirely local: Seshlog reads the agent's transcripts read-only, never writes to them, and makes no network requests — no telemetry, no analytics, nothing leaves your machine.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Unreleased
  • The parsed-transcript cache is persisted in the IDE's system directory, so the first scan after a restart no longer re-reads every transcript. It holds session metadata only — no message content.
  • Fork Session: continue a session's conversation under a new session id (--fork-session), from the Seshlog context menu or by right-clicking a Terminal tab Seshlog knows the session of.
  • Own our tabs: "Resume" on a live session running in one of this project's terminal tabs becomes "Show Tab" and focuses it; tab titles follow the session title when Claude names the session later.
  • Restore after restart: sessions that were live when the IDE closed are offered for resuming when the project reopens (Ask / Always / Never).
  • Preview pane: the selected session's last messages, with a "last N messages" control and a toolbar toggle.
  • Search across transcript content (user prompts and assistant replies), not just titles; results ranked by hits with a snippet.
0.1.0
  • Initial MVP: Claude Code session list and one-click resume.
